Messages.Body:
If I used Dual Form on Wynn, would the dual form vamp be considered
Gangrel independent rather than Cam?

Thanks,
John Zbyszinski

Messages.Author: jnew...@difsol.com
Messages.Body:


Yes, the Gangrel clan is now independent by default, and the card does
not say that it copies sect (so it takes the default).

John
